post.description:
Positions and open interest from the CFTC Disaggregated - Combined report for one or many markets and weeks. Use `markets` first to find contract_market_code values; use `fields` to keep the payload small.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

commodity_group_name.description: Exact commodity_group_name, case-insensitive: AGRICULTURE, NATURAL RESOURCES, FINANCIAL INSTRUMENTS.

commodity_name.description: Exact commodity_name, case-insensitive (GOLD, WHEAT, NATURAL GAS, BITCOIN).

commodity_subgroup_name.description: Exact commodity_subgroup_name, case-insensitive (GRAINS, PRECIOUS METALS, PETROLEUM AND PRODUCTS, CURRENCIES, STOCK INDICES, ...).

contract_market_code.description: Exact cftc_contract_market_code, a string with leading zeros kept (088691 = GOLD - COMMODITY EXCHANGE INC., 001602 = WHEAT-SRW - CBOT). Discover codes with `markets`. Alone, a code with no rows in this dataset is not_found; combined with date or other filters an empty page is a legitimate empty result. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9]{1,12}$.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page of the same query (the SODA $offset).

exchange_code.description: cftc_market_code without its padding: CBT, CME, CMX, NYME, ICUS, ICEU, CMXE, FREX... Matches the padded value the dataset stores ('CMX '). Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9]{1,4}$.

fields.description: Projection: SODA column names to return (open_interest_all, noncomm_positions_long_all, m_money_positions_long_all, ...). The identity columns id, market_and_exchange_names, report_date_as_yyyy_mm_dd and cftc_contract_market_code are always included. An unknown column is invalid_input. Omit for every column.

from.description: Earliest report date to include, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive). Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

page_size.description:
Rows per page (a legacy row is ~4.7 KB, a disaggregated row ~7 KB).

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 1000; default 100.

query.description: SODA full-text search ($q) over the text columns, e.g. `gold` or `chicago board of trade`.

report_date.description: One weekly report date (a Tuesday), YYYY-MM-DD. Not combinable with from / to. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

sort.description:
Order by report date then id. The upstream default order is undefined, so an order is always sent.

Provider reference: allowed values ["recent_first", "oldest_first"]; default "recent_first".

to.description: Latest report date to include, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive). Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints
